title: Normalized compact-support coefficient exchange model
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and schemes $X,X',Y,Y'$ with compactifications $c$ of $f:X\to Y$ and $c'$ of $f':X'\to Y'$, a proper Cartesian square and an open-immersion square between their factors [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Assume $f$ quasi-compact and $X,Y'$ noetherian of finite dimension with $\ell$ invertible. Use the integral and rational stages and scalar systems of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category]. A normalized exchange model consists of two ambient completed scalar/pullback maps fixed by their ordinary-to-completed unit equations; preservation witnesses for the source $Lg^*Rp_*j_!$ and target $Rp'_*j'_!Lg'^*$ composites; two coherent exact stage-system morphisms with these integral localizations; inverse scalar-comparison equations identifying their beta inverses with the localized open-unit/proper-counit mate composites; and a compatible transformation whose every integral component is the localization of the specified completed compact-support exchange [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], for every finite generating tuple of the adic ideal. The membership witnesses are proofs only. No invertibility of this exchange is imposed. This is precisely the existing CbcQbarExchangeModel and its scalar-comparison definitions, extracted without changing any data or signature.
